CustomField.description: Which of the three § 37 MessEG paths this event takes, because the consequence differs per path. Eingriff (Abs. 2 Nr. 2): an intervention that CAN affect metrological properties ends the Eichfrist early - the test is can, not did. Instandsetzung (Abs. 5): repair by an authorised repairer is exempt from that early termination, but only if all four conditions hold together. Software-Update (Abs. 6): the Eichfrist is expressly untouched, yet the device may not operate until the authority approves. Nacheichung: the re-calibration itself, which restarts the period.
